title: Aurora Watch
text:
🌌 Aurora Watch — November 07, 2026

Earth's magnetic field is officially getting stirred up. Geomagnetic storm levels are active, and Aurora Watch is on.

🌎 Kp: 5.33 (G1 Storm Level)
🧲 IMF Bz: -1.5 nT (Southward)
💨 Solar wind: 671 km/s (Fast)
🚨 NOAA: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 5
☀️ Solar driver context: CH-HSS

Okay, now we're glowing. ✨

Aurora visibility still depends on location, darkness, cloud cover, and how the magnetic field evolves from here. ✨

Image: NOAA SWPC — OVATION Aurora Forecast
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
